# Controller 1 for tools/shift_check.py, from power-on with a blank EEPROM
# (frame, BUTTONS word in hex, held from that frame on; m64p's BUTTONS: 0x10
# START, 0x80 A, the stick's X in bits 16-23 and Y in bits 24-31).
#
# 300-10379: START and A in turn every 30 frames.  10380-10799: A every 30
# frames (no more START: in a stage it pauses).  10800-24000: walk the
# stage, a different direction every 120 frames, with A (a bomb) 40 frames
# into each.  The stage is in play to the end (these inputs change its
# state; the same run without them doesn't move).
#
# The path, with the overlay loaded (the same in us and eu; us's frames,
# eu's in brackets): mode select (ovl_0B_01: Adventure, Battle, Custom,
# Options) from 128 [105], ovl_0A_05 from 577 [517], ovl_0B_01 again from
# 697 [637], file select (ovl_0B_06; START/A take the first file and the
# default difficulty) from 851 [791], the opening (ovl_0A_02 and ovl_0A_01
# in turn) from 1053 [958], world select (ovl_0B_02) from 10178 [9948], the
# first stage (ovl_0C_01) from 10569 [10359] to the end.  With a save that already has a file, START/A
# would go from file select straight to the world select and the stage.
